App GraphQL login is `cairnwright` with type `Bot`; REST login is `cairnwright[bot]`. Both normalize to the mint identity. |
| G14 convergence | App self-removal re-holds a same-head new finding; human removal/ready overrides an App hold; user-token hold does not override; new head re-holds; either resolver removes only its resolved thread. |
| Attribution, real Git fixtures | Human commits receive one trailer; existing trailers are not duplicated; autonomous commits receive none; commits already published to a branch or tag remain unchanged. |
| Reviewer and wire tests | Human requester identity crosses the step wire without credentials; review requests survive repeated polls and skip requested/reviewed/autonomous/scheduled/intake/PR-author cases. Missing-trailer notices deduplicate per head. |
| Runner credential tests | Authentication refresh then success; second authentication failure terminates without machine fallback; proactive refresh after 50 minutes; refreshed and initial values redacted from output/session uploads. |
| Tag refresh follow-up | 30 tests passed across `tag-tool`, `runner-create-tag`, `runner-cred-fallback`: real local HTTP Git rejects the expired App credential, then accepts one refreshed credential; runner wiring shares the 50-minute/bounded-retry policy. |
| `node --test ops/app-token-mint/mint.test.mjs` | 8 passed. |
| Focused final run | 14 files, 242 tests passed: daemon `step-attribution`, `runner-cred-fallback`, `runner-session-upload`; server `github-work-attribution`, `pr-review-findings`, `github-app-token`, `github-oauth`, `github-token-refresh`, `github-connection-migration`, `g2t2-executor-wire`, `m4a-chief-loop`, `chief-dispatch`, `m3b-machine-git`; shared wire `snapshot`. |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --changed` | 9360 passed, 1 expected failure, 1 skipped; 1 failed: unchanged `podman-runtime.test.ts` cannot mkdir `/home/ian/.cp-*/cairn-orb-egress` in this sandbox. File hash matches origin/main. Late tag-path wiring additionally passed the focused follow-up below. |
| `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm spec:parse`, `pnpm prepush` | Passed on the final edits; prepush passed 23 checks. Spec parsing collected 1530 web tests and parsed 70 integration files. Fetch unavailable, local origin/main used. |

### Requirement

[Owner proposal](https://github.com/xiechimon/cairn/blob/server/app-identity-split/docs/research/bot-identity-and-coauthorship-2026-11-07.md)

> work ian instructed carries ian as co-author; anything cairn does on its own uses the `cairnwright` App

### Requests

| Clause | Request | Response | Before → after | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Before | Read-only GraphQL #3401 | Hold/ready actor `xiechimon` | Actors indistinguishable → App attribution in #3409 | Live reads; no screenshot |
| Actor hold | Read-only GraphQL #3409 | `LabeledEvent`: `cairnwright`, type `Bot` | Raw GraphQL login → normalized `cairnwright[bot]` | Live reads; no screenshot |
| Human reviewer | `POST /repos/o/r/pulls/1/requested_reviewers` | `200`, mocked | 0 → 1 request across repeated polls | Stateful fetch fake; no real write/screenshot |

### Schema changes

| table | change | detail |
|---|---|---|
| `github_connection` | + githubName | text |
| `github_connection` | + githubUserId | integer |


```text
Live: read-only GitHub GraphQL on #3401/#3409; real local Git objects, HTTP tag-push authentication, branch/tag fetches and Unix mint sockets with throwaway keys.
Mocked: GitHub write responses, requested/reviewed state, OAuth user identity, token expiry/refresh and agent runtime; no production writes.
Not covered: real App review requests/status writes, deployment, agent-shell trailer enforcement/token refresh, screenshots, CI on the eventual commit; no separate e2e run.
```

## What

Segments 1–3 split App writes from human actions, restore actor-based G14 overrides, enforce human co-authorship before daemon pushes, request human review once, and refresh long-step credentials. PR #3413.

<details><summary>Review and risk</summary>

## Review

Codex cloud review runs on the PR head. No local model review was run. The implementation follows the supplied research linked above and its segment 3 reconnaissance; this lane only leaves worktree edits and handoff metadata.

## Risk

Two-way application change; additive nullable database columns require migration. Host mint deployment remains owner-controlled and off until configured. Protected paths require cloud review on the final head. Owner-routed/protected or outside-auto-merge paths touched across all three segments, measured with the repository's routing globs:

| Path | Routing surface |
| --- | --- |
| `biome.json` | Protected lint seam |
| `apps/server/src/services/machine-finish-step.ts` | Machine boundary, segment 2 |
| `apps/server/src/services/machine-step-token.ts` | Machine boundary, segments 2/3 |
| `apps/server/src/services/oauth.ts` | Credential connection, segment 3 |
| `apps/server/drizzle/0122_github_attribution.sql` | Additive database migration |
| `apps/server/drizzle/meta/_journal.json` | Database migration journal |
| `apps/server/drizzle/meta/0122_snapshot.json` | Database schema snapshot |
| `ops/app-token-mint/README.md` | Outside auto-merge paths |
| `ops/app-token-mint/cairn-app-token-mint.service` | Outside auto-merge paths; host credential boundary |
| `ops/app-token-mint/mint.mjs` | Outside auto-merge paths; host mint |
| `ops/app-token-mint/mint.test.mjs` | Outside auto-merge paths |

The smallest enforceable trailer mechanism is daemon pre-push normalization: daemon-created commits receive the trailer directly; for agent-created commits, fetch origin heads and tags, exclude published commits and pre-step history, rebuild only remaining commit objects, and compare-and-swap the branch ref. Trees, topology and author/committer metadata survive. Existing repository hooks remain intact; no hooksPath override, force push or remote-history rewrite is used. Rebuilt signed commit objects lose their original signatures. Unknown step-start heads are not rewritten. Direct agent-shell or tag publication can precede branch normalization; already-published commit objects remain untouched and missing trailers are reported through per-head PR commit notices.

A running child shell receives literal GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/git environment values. Daemon refresh cannot change that process environment; later commands in that existing shell may still fail after expiry. Daemon prepare/branch-push/tag-push operations refresh once and reject non-App replacement credentials. Every step-token issuance requests a fresh App mint, rather than returning a possibly revoked cached installation credential.

Legacy connections lack numeric GitHub IDs until reconnected through the existing `/user` read. Historical coordinator todos without durable human requester provenance fail closed and receive no guessed credit. Scheduled builds/continuations and intake-created work receive no human trailer. The bounded latest-100 timeline fails closed when it cannot see the current-head boundary or App hold. Missing timestamps and unavailable attribution reads also fail closed/defer, without blocking ordinary PR watch convergence.

author: occupiedporcupine
body:
## What this does
This is the indexing and search half of the stall documents RAG (#150). Every document saved on the Documents page is now split into chunks, embedded, and stored for similarity search. The assistant starts using it in #153.

- **Chunking** (`DocumentChunker`): chunks of up to about 450 tokens. It splits at headings (`#` lines, which `.docx` headings become) and blank lines first, then between lines (tables, lists), then sentences. It only cuts mid-sentence when a single sentence is longer than a whole chunk. A chunk that continues a section starts with the section's heading and the last sentence or two before it, up to 60 tokens. Small sections share a chunk. Chinese is counted as one token per character and split at `。！？；`. The embedded text starts with `Document: <title>`, so "Order by 9pm" still matches "Ah Huat Poultry".
- **Embeddings** (`EmbeddingClient`, picked by `app.assistant.provider` like the chat model):
  - `OpenAiEmbeddingClient`: `text-embedding-3-small`, 1536 dimensions, all of a document's chunks in one call. I checked against the account's `/v1/models` that it's still the current small model.
  - `OfflineEmbeddingClient`: hashed word counts, deterministic, so tests and CI need no key.
  - Model, dimensions and the similarity floor are in `application.properties` (`app.documents.*`). The floor is 0.3 for now; #155 tunes it.
- **Storage**: `stall_document_chunks`, V38 in both `h2/` and `postgresql/`.
  - On Postgres it enables pgvector in Supabase's `extensions` schema, or wherever it already is, adds a `vector(1536)` column and an HNSW `vector_cosine_ops` index, and turns on RLS with grants revoked. `PgVectorDocumentSearch` qualifies the type and the `<=>` operator with the extension's schema, so the search path doesn't matter. It also refuses to start if the configured dimensions don't match the column.
  - H2 stores the vector as bytes, and `InMemoryDocumentSearch` scores cosine similarity in Java.
- **Search**: `DocumentSearch.top(ownerId, query, model, k, minSimilarity)`. Every query filters by `owner_id` on both the chunk and the document, and only compares chunks from the current model.
- **Indexing** (`DocumentIndexer`) runs in the request that saved the document, outside the transaction, so no database connection waits on OpenAI.
  - If embedding fails, the document stays saved and is marked `FAILED`, and its old chunks are deleted so the assistant never answers from outdated text. `POST /api/documents/{id}/index` and a **Try again** button on the page retry it.
  - An edit made while a document is being indexed wins.
  - On startup, chunks from another embedding model, and documents left `PENDING`, are embedded again (up to 100 per start).
- **Usage**: V39 adds `embedding_tokens` to `assistant_daily_usage`. Tokens are recorded per stall, appear in `GET /api/admin/assistant-usage`, and are priced at `app.assistant.prices.embedding-per-million-tokens` ($0.02).

## How it was tested
- `./mvnw verify`: 317 tests pass.
  - `DocumentChunkerTest` covers short documents, heading splits, small sections sharing a chunk, the heading and overlap on continued chunks, never cutting sentences, Chinese, tables split between rows, a lone heading never becoming a chunk, and very long words.
  - `DocumentIndexingTest` covers indexing on save, re-indexing on edit, chunks cascading on delete, `FAILED` with old chunks dropped when embedding throws, Try again working afterwards, best match first, unrelated text dropped, re-embedding chunks from another model on startup, and **two owners: B's search never returns A's chunks**.
- I ran it locally against `supabase/postgres:17.11.0.013`, the CI image. All 39 migrations applied, `scripts/ci/check-supabase-lockdown.sql` passed, and creating and editing documents over HTTP gave 1536-dimension chunks in `extensions.vector`.
- I checked `EXPLAIN` by hand. With a constant query vector the planner uses `Index Scan using stall_document_chunks_embedding_idx`. With the owner filter it prefers `stall_document_chunks_owner_id_idx`, which is the right plan: a stall has at most a few hundred chunks, and filtering by owner first gives exact rather than approximate results.

Migrations: V38 (h2 and postgresql) and V39 (common). No other open PR touches migrations.

Note for production: V38 runs `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector WITH SCHEMA extensions` on chicky-prod. Supabase allows this for the `postgres` role.

## Checklist
- [x] Tests pass (`cd backend && ./mvnw test`)
- [x] If this adds or changes UI, it follows `frontend/DESIGN.md` (only the Try again text button)
- [x] If this adds or changes UI, `app-guide.json` and the `data-guide-id` attributes are updated (no new guided elements)
- [x] If this adds a table, the migration enables row level security

Closes #152. Part of #150.

author: lawrencecchen
body:
## Summary

When a Chromium page holds the key, a press on a split divider (or a column, row or sidebar edge) made the shell window key first. That key change was the press's whole cost: `-[NSThemeFrame _windowChangedKeyState]` redrew every control of the window, 101 view layouts and an 18.9 ms mouse-down frame on the drag's first refresh (RESIZE P0 7, px-col-drag-2-s1r, cmux21 120 Hz). The page also lost the key, so a resize moved the focus away from the page.

Now a divider press keeps the page's key and focus, as in Chrome, where a splitter is not focusable and the window stays key.

Path (from the P0 7 stack): `DividerMouseCatcherView.forward` -> `ShellWindow.sendEvent` -> `FirstClickPolicy` -> `makeKey` -> `-[NSWindow makeKeyWindow]` -> `_windowChangedKeyState`.

Fix: `WindowPressRouter` (CmuxNextDesign, moved out of the app target) runs first in `ShellWindow.sendEvent`. A left press on a `KeyNeutralPressTarget` (`DividerHandleView`, `SidebarResizeHandle`) goes straight to that view, with its drags, force-click `.pressure` stages and release, when all of these are true:

- the app is active and no modal runs,
- this window is not key and has no sheet,
- the key window is a page of this window: every window from it up to this window is a page window (`WindowOverlayHost.isPageWindow`: a Chromium page, a remote browser popup, or a page's own DevTools or popup). A key-capable child panel (the group-editor bubble, the screenshot section overlay) is not a page: it dismisses on resign-key, so a divider press closes it as before.

Once the router takes a press, it keeps every left drag, force-click stage and the release until that release, also when the divider leaves the window mid-drag (a pane closed by a socket or an agent). AppKit never got that press, so its mouse-down view is an earlier press's view; nothing of the press falls through to it.

Every other press keeps `FirstClickPolicy` as before.

Entry points:

| Entry point | cmux now | Chrome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse press on a divider over a page (catcher panel forwards to `ShellWindow.sendEvent`) | router: no key change, drag starts | splitter not focusable; web contents keep focus; one key window stays key |
| Mouse press on a divider outside a page, page holds the key | same router | same |
| Trackpad force click | its `leftMouseDown` takes the same route; `.pressure` goes to the pressed divider | same as a press |
| First click into an inactive app's window, or behind another main window | unchanged: AppKit activates the window, the divider takes the first mouse | `BridgedContentView acceptsFirstMouse` = YES: the window activates and the click acts |

## Testing

Red/green command (fleet):

```
cmux-ci run --class light --script scripts/ci/run-swift-testing-suites.sh --ref SHA \
  --env CMUX_SWIFT_TEST_SUITES=DividerPressKeepsPageKeyTests --arg Packages/macOS/CmuxNext
```

- Red at ccd769f44f4, step `428184ff2899cf584c4398e1` (aws-m4pro-3): the divider and the sidebar edge press each made 1 key request (want 0). The pane-press test passed.
- Red again at the final test rig b69f5298a5c, step `a742270de97529b08d31f303` (aws-m4pro-6): the divider press made 1 key request and the divider moved 0 pt (want > 30); the sidebar edge made 1 key request and grew 0 pt (want > 20). The pane-press and inactive-app tests passed. The press-turn layout bound did not fail at the red, because the rig counts `makeKey` and does not run AppKit's key change.
- Green at 2433c6e72af, step `529ba2dd341658e7eca9405a` (aws-m4pro-6): DividerPressKeepsPageKeyTests, DividerDragTerminalResizeCountTests, SplitTerminalResizeCountTests, SidebarResizeAbovePageTests, DividerCatcherMotionTests pass. FirstClickPolicyTests `anAttachedSheetKeepsTheKeys` and ParkedPageCatcherPanelsTests `aZoomAndUnzoomLandingMoveNoCatcherPanelForAParkedPage` fail. Both fail the same way on the base 045a3a4aa73, step `4fcc3cd06ea85548494d8405` (aws-m4pro-6), so they are base findings.
- Display step `d68d75f43fb72749fb0cf104` (cmuxs-Mac-mini-4, `--display` with `CMUX_TEST_REQUIRE_GUI=1`, so the GUI suites do not skip): DividerPressKeepsPageKeyTests, TerminalDividerDragFrameTests and TerminalDragShownGridTests pass, 0 skipped.
- Build `79eb4c361c456186473bcf27`, tag `chrome-parity-resize-p0-8-m1-v1` (done).
- `scripts/cmux-next/os-matrix.sh --build 79eb4c361c456186473bcf27 --os 14,15`, step `1a26393690e86054f84ef2b6`: smoke PASS on 14.8.7 and 15.7.7, 0 crashes, 0 hang reports, 0 faults. The smoke does not drag a divider.

### RESIZE P0 9 (review 6711259901 findings 1 and 2)

- Tests d8346f21f6b: `aDividerThatLeavesMidDragKeepsItsPressUntilTheRelease`, `aDividerPressWhileAChildPanelHoldsTheKeyMakesTheWindowKey`, guard `aDividerPressWhileAPagesOwnChildHoldsTheKeyMovesNoKey`.
- Red at d8346f21f6b, step `d1db4663367d3aba5f87f8fc` (aws-m4pro-7): the 2 new tests fail (late drag and release fell through; the child panel press was routed with 0 key requests, want 1); the guard and the 4 older tests pass.
- Fix 7a5ab488694 (`claimed` flag; `isPage` chain), compile fix 6dda366a838, feat merged at 486e0fd770b.
- Green at 6dda366a838, step `7fa2ef94c28f61117041b3fe`: DividerPressKeepsPageKeyTests (7 tests), SidebarResizeAbovePageTests, DividerCatcherMotionTests, DividerDragTerminalResizeCountTests, SplitTerminalResizeCountTests pass. FirstClickPolicyTests `anAttachedSheetKeepsTheKeys` fails headless, as on the base (above).
- Display step `a123b772b5386ce8bd06aa6e` (cmux14, `--display`, `CMUX_TEST_REQUIRE_GUI=1`): DividerPressKeepsPageKeyTests, FirstClickPolicyTests, ParkedPageCatcherPanelsTests 3/3 pass.
- Build `179c5022879bf5a4204de3e9`, tag `chrome-parity-resize-p0-9-m1-v5` (aws-m4pro-6; the Linux pool builds 4620357e and 9298578f failed "import set record failed after the hidden-input rebuild", infra).
- `scripts/cmux-next/os-matrix.sh --build 179c5022879bf5a4204de3e9 --os 14,15`, step `4e788aade0f5a9f09c89b848`: smoke PASS on 14.8.7 and 15.7.7, 0 crashes, 0 hang reports, 0 faults.
- Not run: a live drag with a page key in the tagged build; pressure events after the divider leaves (same path as drags, no test).

### Observed / Not run

Observed: the fleet steps above. Not run:

- A live drag in the tagged build with a page holding the key. No frame or layout count was taken for the fixed build, so the 18.9 ms frame is not proven gone.
- The press-turn bound (`pressLayouts = 4`) is not from data, and it is not red at the base in the rig (see red step `a742270d`). The test rig changed after the first red (b69f5298a5c: flush the window's own pass before counting; inactive case checks the key only); the red was run again at that commit.
- The inactive-app case is checked for "no key request" only. AppKit does not deliver a synthesized press to a window that is not on screen.

Notes:

- The branch merged feat (after #37916) at 486e0fd770b.
- Routed presses skip `focusOnScreenWorkspace` (multi-view). A divider press does not move the focus, so this is intended, but a reviewer should check it.

## Changelog

Fixed: Dragging a split or sidebar edge while a browser page has focus no longer moves the focus or stutters on the first frame

For LucaKro/GitHubWorkflow#248: `GitCommandRunner.delete_remote_branches(remote, tips)` deletes several branches in **one push**. Each refspec carries `--force-with-lease=<ref>:<commit>`, so a branch that has moved since is left alone. It returns the branches *not* deleted, read from `git push --porcelain` (lines flagged `-` were deleted): those that moved, and those the remote refused. N deletions now take one round trip instead of N.

author: jakegoodmandev
body:
## Summary

```text
push main / manual main dispatch
  migrate job: main-only → production-migrations environment
    serialized, no in-flight cancellation
    setup-cli resolves CLI 3.0.0 from bun.lock
    link → db push --remote --yes --skip-vault
  Vercel (independent)
    build only
```

Removes Drizzle production migration/check scripts and tests; keeps local Drizzle tooling for #256. Supabase history is authoritative; read-only MCP now permits `list_migrations`. No new dependencies. Checkout does not persist credentials; no canary Bun setup. Concurrency is job-level so skipped non-main dispatches cannot displace pending main jobs.

**Ordering:** For the one-time #240 merge, production has no real users: accept the brief window where Vercel may deploy before migrations finish. Watch the first migration run and use **Vercel Instant Rollback** if it fails; retry migrations and redeploy after success. No legacy data transfer or schema drops. For later releases use expand → migrate → activate → contract across separate releases; failed migrations do not gate Vercel. Deployment Checks are a possible future gate, not implemented here.

**First run:** Supabase's documented `db push` behavior creates its history table and executes all pending files. Empty Supabase history means all local migrations are pending regardless of the legacy Drizzle ledger. SQL replay does not diff/reset or alter legacy `app`/`drizzle`. CLI v3 requires explicit remote targeting and confirmation.

### Human setup before main merge

- [ ] Confirm production project ref (MCP currently names `aopcockhbfvonhvxufob`) against Dashboard and Vercel's Supabase URL.
- [ ] Create GitHub environment **`production-migrations`**, distinct from Vercel's `Production`. Set deployment branches/tags to selected rules: **branch `main` only**, no tag rule, before adding secrets.
- [ ] Add **environment secrets only**: `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD`, `SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF`. Remove any repository/organization copies: workflows on other branches can access broader secrets.
- [ ] Scope the token to production and grant Read scopes: `project_admin_read`, `projects_read`, `database_pooling_config_read` (IPv4 pooler fallback), `api_gateway_keys_read`, `api_gateway_keys_secret_read`. Verified against current Supabase PAT guide and CLI help. Password-based database access is not constrained by PAT permissions.
- [ ] Confirm Actions access, failure notifications and database connectivity. GitHub-hosted runner IPs are not fixed; if network restrictions are enabled, arrange approved static egress rather than allowlisting one observed IP or opening access broadly.
- [ ] Review pending SQL/backups; watch the initial main run and confirm Supabase history. For #240 use Instant Rollback if it fails.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Vercel ran Drizzle migrate → ledger check → build; Supabase history was unused.
  **After:** `bun run verify` passes after review fixes: 50 files, 659 tests; typecheck/format/lint pass (existing warnings). Local Node shim required already-installed Node 24.22.2 on PATH.
- `actionlint` 1.7.12 validates the revised workflow; `git diff --check` passes. CLI flags and token scopes checked against installed help/current docs. No production credentials, remote link or writes used.
- Updated CI is fully green after the security fixes: lint\/format\/typecheck, unit tests, integration tests, build\/e2e, and Vercel Preview.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** one-way

Code is reversible; production migrations are forward-only after reaching main. User review required before merge.

**Blast Radius:** production

Create the restricted environment and secrets before main rollout. This PR targets the integration branch and does not run production migrations.

author: hellodit
body:
## Ringkasan

Audit database dengan skill `postgres-drizzle` (drizzle-orm 0.45, API relasi 0.x).

1. **Skema per tabel.** `server/db/schema.ts` dipecah jadi `server/db/schema/<tabel>.ts`. Enum ikut tabel pemiliknya, helper kolom di `columns.ts`.
2. **Semua relasi di satu file:** `schema/relations.ts`. Relasi yang sebelumnya belum ada sudah ditambahkan: sesi, akun, transaksi (dua FK ke `users` dengan `relationName`), paket, realisasi dan sumbernya, upload, saran AI, dan salinan rencana aksi.
3. **Selalu pakai relasi.** Data berelasi diambil dengan satu query relasional (`db.query.*` + `with`). Angka turunan dihitung sebagai `extras` di query yang sama. Tidak ada lagi query A lalu query B, dan tidak ada `Promise.all`.
4. **Service layer.** Query panjang pindah ke `server/services/` (auto-import seperti `server/utils`). Endpoint tinggal validasi lalu memanggil service.
5. **Performa:** index foreign key, lebih sedikit round trip, dan penulisan yang tidak perlu dihapus.

Aturan dan jebakannya didokumentasikan di `server/db/README.md`.

## Perubahan utama

### Skema & migrasi
- `drizzle-kit generate` memastikan pemecahan file **tidak mengubah skema** ("No schema changes").
- Migrasi **`0004_fk_indexes`** hanya membuat index (tidak ada perubahan kolom atau data):
  - index untuk FK yang belum ber-index: `action_plans.rhk_id`, `action_plans.copied_from_id` (partial), `period_realizations.period_id`, `realization_sources.progress_id`, `ai_suggestions.user_id`, `transactions.package_id`, `transactions.created_by` (partial). Tanpa index ini, `ON DELETE CASCADE/SET NULL` memindai seluruh tabel anak, misalnya saat akun dihapus atau periode dibuat ulang;
  - dua index untuk halaman admin: `users.created_at` dan `sessions.updated_at`.

### Query
- **Workspace, RHK, rencana aksi, progres, `/api/me`, dan ekspor akun** masing-masing satu query relasional.
- **Realisasi:**
  - progres hanya diambil untuk rencana aksi periode itu (sebelumnya semua progres user, lalu disaring di JS);
  - penulisan hanya terjadi bila draf atau sumbernya berubah, dalam satu transaksi, jadi GET kedua tidak menulis apa pun.
- **Ubah/hapus dengan cek kepemilikan** jadi satu `UPDATE … WHERE … AND exists(milik user) RETURNING`.
- **`syncPlanStatus`** jadi satu `UPDATE … FROM` dan berjalan di transaksi simpan progres (sebelumnya di luar transaksi).
- **Tanggal batas SKP** diubah dengan satu `UPDATE … CASE` (sebelumnya 12 update).
- **Admin:**
  - dashboard: satu statement (subquery skalar + `json_agg`);
  - riwayat transaksi: satu statement (CTE halaman + statistik dari satu scan);
  - daftar pengguna: statistik ditambah satu query relasional;
  - paket: agregat per paket di-`LEFT JOIN`.
- **Sesi Better Auth** dibaca sekali per request (sebelumnya dua kali: middleware + handler).

### Jebakan Drizzle 0.x yang ditangani
Query satu tabel (tanpa join), dan query relasional root tanpa `with`, menulis kolom tanpa nama tabel. Akibatnya subquery berkorelasi bisa diam-diam mengikat `"id"` ke tabel di dalam subquery. Ini sempat terdeteksi saat pengujian:
- jumlah transaksi per paket bernilai 0;
- cek "SKP sudah punya rencana aksi" selalu 0.

Keduanya sudah diperbaiki dengan agregat + `LEFT JOIN`, dan dicatat di README database.

## Hasil

**Jumlah SQL per request** (20 endpoint utama, di luar baca sesi): **166 → 71**. Contoh:

| Endpoint | Sebelum | Sesudah |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/me` | 7 | 2 |
| `/api/dashboard` | 13 | 5 |
| `/api/realizations` | 18 | 5 |
| `/api/account/export` | 11 | 2 |

**Latensi median dengan jeda database ≈10 ms** (disimulasikan; build lama vs baru di database yang sama):

| Endpoint | Lama | Baru |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/me` | 174–182 ms | 69–74 ms |
| `/api/dashboard` | 333–340 ms | 137–141 ms |
| `/api/realizations` (data besar) | 708 ms | 137 ms |
| Ekspor akun (data besar) | 272 ms | 86 ms |
| Admin pengguna | 154 ms | 114 ms |
| Admin transaksi / dashboard / paket | ~89–90 ms | ~89–90 ms |

Rata-rata endpoint pengguna 2,4× lebih cepat, dan tidak ada endpoint admin yang lebih lambat.

**Beban serentak** (40 request, 10 sekaligus):
- `/api/realizations`: 5 → 68 request/detik.
- **Versi lama gagal 26 dari 40 request** dengan 500 (duplicate key di `realization_sources`, karena setiap GET menghapus lalu mengisi ulang sumber). Versi baru: 0 error.

## Catatan deploy
- Jalankan **`bun run db:migrate`** (migrasi `0004`, hanya `CREATE INDEX`).
- Perubahan respons yang terlihat dari luar:
  - `expiringSoon[].until` di dashboard admin kini format ISO standar (`2026-11-09T19:27:22…+00:00`);
  - urutan `realizations` di file ekspor akun dikelompokkan per RHK (isinya sama).

## Pengujian
- `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test` (87 test), dan `bun run build` lolos.
- Respons 44 endpoint baca dibandingkan dengan build lama: identik, kecuali dua catatan di atas.
- 33 uji jalur tulis lewat API lulus:
  - nomor RHK baru dan bulk;
  - posisi rencana aksi dan bukti;
  - status otomatis berjalan/selesai;
  - pindah progres antar rencana aksi;
  - salin rencana aksi;
  - realisasi dan salin;
  - batas tanggal dan guard frekuensi SKP;
  - pengaturan dan onboarding;
  - hapus;
  - akses data milik user lain → 404.
- Benchmark: user demo dan user data besar (10 RHK, 480 rencana aksi, 666 progres), database lokal dan dengan jeda jaringan ≈10 ms.

Sabit #885 kaynağı: **69950f289a012f0bb7c61290bec9890f340f6c64**. Bu taslak #885 dalını hedefler; diff yalnız sekiz yeni tanı script/test/kanıt dosyasıdır. Üretim kodu, timeout veya worker mekanizması değiştirilmedi.

Gerçek native ortak havuz + iki gerçek 30k projeksiyonla 36 kontrollü koşu: KUR yok/geçerli × soğuk/ısınmış/dolu havuz × baz/aday × üç tekrar, AB/BA/AB. Baz FX yolu Main #888'in tam sync/client/Excel worker/store/route kodudur; aynı aday ortak havuz baskısı altında çalıştırıldı. F0 UI/refresh serisinin yeniden oynatılması değildir.

**Kök neden kanıtı:** bazda 0/18 timeout; adayda 6/18, altısı da dolu havuzda. Her timeout'ta gerçek timer ≈5001 ms'de çalıştı; FX dispatch ve worker receive yok, native queueWait≈5001 ms, duration=0, postMessage=0. İki aktif worker ve bir pending FX işinin zaman damgaları kaydedildi; 24 projeksiyon işi tamamlandı. Boş havuzlarda timeout yok. Worker açılışı ve parse olayları ayrı preload/observer kanalıyla kaydedilir; fake timer veya yapay spin yükü yok.

**Eşdeğerlik:** boş havuzlarda FX veri/revision/yanıt eşit. KUR yok + dolu havuzda veri/revision korunur ama aday folderSync/sonuç parse-failed olur. Geçerli KUR + dolu havuzda baz Ekim'i revision 2 ile kaydeder; aday eski Eylül/revision 1'de kalır. Catch saveFx/publish çağırmaz: yanlış kur yazımı gözlenmedi; güncelleme ve durum eşdeğerliği başarısızdır. /api/fx her iki durumda HTTP 200 dönebildiğinden gövde/resolve da karşılaştırıldı.

**Öneri, uygulanmadı:** dosyasız otomatik FX'i async KUR keşfiyle havuza almadan aynı no-file sonucuyla bitir. Geçerli KUR için ilk bulk işler öncesi mevcut warmup zincirinde sıralama ayrı doğrulanmalı; zaten >5 sn işlerle dolu non-preemptive havuzda öncelik tek başına çözmez. Kuyruk timeout'u parse hatası diye sunulmamalı. Yeni worker veya timeout artışı önerilmiyor.

[Kanıt ve tekrar üretme](https://github.com/clbiez/Buyer-Log-Desktop/blob/diag/phase5-fx-timeout/docs/performance-program/phase-5-fx-diagnosis/README.md) · [Ham 36 iz](https://github.com/clbiez/Buyer-Log-Desktop/blob/diag/phase5-fx-timeout/docs/performance-program/phase-5-fx-diagnosis/results.json) · [Özet/hash'ler](https://github.com/clbiez/Buyer-Log-Desktop/blob/diag/phase5-fx-timeout/docs/performance-program/phase-5-fx-diagnosis/summary.json).

Yeni tanı/kanıt testi ve beş mevcut ilgili FX test dosyası: **29 PASS; fail/skip/cancel 0**. İlk metadata preflight hatası saklandı. Tam regresyon çalıştırılmadı. GitHub Actions run'ı tetiklenmedi: hızlı workflow yalnız main hedefini kapsıyor; bu taslak #885 dalını hedefliyor. CI başarısı iddia edilmez.

Tarihsel dört F0 hatasının per-job zaman damgaları yok; her birini geriye dönük kesin faza atama iddiası yok. Aynı sabit adayda kontrollü kuyruk nedeni yeniden üretildi. B1 genel kabulü veya üretim düzeltmesi tamamlandı denmiyor.

author: panchenkoai
body:
## Why
Owner decision 2026-11-07: the E2E matrix (pre leg plus three nextest partitions) is the slowest per-PR job and overlaps the nightly full live suite, so it runs nightly. A red nightly must name what changed since the last green one.

## What
- `ci.yml` loses `e2e-scope`, `e2e-build`, `e2e`, `e2e-skipped`, `e2e-matrix`. The path-scope planner (`e2e_scope.py`) and the measured leg planner (`e2e_legs.py`) are deleted, so the owned-path, always-full and unused lists no longer exist.
- `nightly-live.yml` (existing `30 3 * * *` cron) gains `e2e-build`, `e2e` (legs pre, 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 by `--partition count:i/N`), `e2e-matrix` (skip census and verdict census, lane ci) and `nightly-verdict`. The verdict job needs every other nightly job, fails the run if any is not green, and prints the first-parent merges since the last green nightly (`.github/scripts/nightly_range.py`, bounded to 30 when no green exists). Failure mail is the existing GitHub failed-scheduled-run notification.
- `live_owners.py` holds the module-owner rule on its own; `live_modules` imports it directly instead of loading it by path.
- `ci_gate_steps_guard` reads each gate from the workflow that owns it and grades that `nightly-verdict` needs exactly the other nightly jobs. `workflow_stack_guard` grades per job that `live-full` starts every service the e2e job starts. `live_skip_policy_guard` reads the e2e job from the nightly.
- Docs and the pre-push hook describe E2E as nightly. Push to main no longer runs E2E.

## Required checks to drop from the main ruleset
- `E2E matrix`
- `E2E (pre)`

`E2E scope`, `E2E (1/3)`, `E2E (2/3)`, `E2E (3/3)` were never required. Drop the two before enqueuing this PR, otherwise the merge queue waits for names that no longer exist.

author: mrlightek
body:
Studio needs a built-in way to create production assets without a third-party generation account. This adds an asset workshop for editable shapes, sets, stages, lighting and animated effects, with size and surface controls. Creators can add them to an existing scene or open a new production with cameras and lighting.

The workspace can snapshot a saved scene into a reusable .blend asset, prepare its native object inventory and optional GLB preview, and reopen it as an independent editable production. Source exports preserve credits and resource bundles where present, use bounded Studio queue jobs, and expose failures and retry controls. The existing production wizard remains available.

The control room links directly to the workshop and asset browser. Runtime health starts Blender in its restricted container rather than only inspecting the image. The media image explicitly installs NumPy for the GLTF exporter, and the installer probes it. Includes capability migration, PWA cache update and acceptance workflow coverage.

Validation:
- New server checks: 8 tests, 65 assertions, no failures or skips, including a real Blender 4.0.2 creation → .blend save → GLB preview → native reopen round trip.
- Existing regression plus new checks: 79 tests, 827 assertions, no failures; 8 optional Blender checks skipped in that separate run.
- Installer/archive/transform/deploy checks: 11 passed.
- DOM form checks passed for scene/version payloads, save receipts, errors and preservation of the existing production wizard. JavaScript syntax, shell syntax and diff checks passed.

Limits: production installation has not been verified or changed. The quoted deployed Tripo prompt was not found in develop and its deployment remains unverified. The workshop performs procedural creation, not AI text-to-3D inference. Full mesh/sculpt/rig/node-graph authoring and automatic live scene compositing remain outside this change. Full browser visual QA was not completed because the test browser download failed.

Deployment: apply migration 20261107153000, rebuild the Studio media dependency image through the existing setup/deployment pipeline, and restart the app and Studio queue workers.

Dois commits. Mesclar depois dos outros dois PRs (não há conflito; é só a ordem combinada).

**1. Emendas de deputados nas obras** (`emendas_obras.py` → `site/dados/emendas/`)
- Liga o autor de emenda individual às obras de SP pelo código exato da emenda no empenho do ObrasGov e na CGU, com a regra de deputado do site. Dry-run: 464 vínculos, 462 obras, 47 deputados (todos de SP).
- Publica um arquivo por deputado + `indice.json`, trocados de uma vez; seção "Obras com emenda deste deputado" no perfil e a linha da emenda em `obras.html`. Nunca soma valores por pessoa.
- Aliases para os 3 códigos de autor que a CGU grava com duas grafias (conferidos no histórico da Câmara).
- Erro de fonte nunca vira "sem emenda": cada página do ObrasGov é conferida; cópia da CGU só até 3 dias; esquemas conferidos antes de publicar; `git add -A` leva as exclusões para o commit.

**2. Tempo da rodada** (em 25/10 a rodada foi cancelada no limite com um passo em 317 min, e nada foi publicado)
- `passo.py`: teto por passo e orçamento dos opcionais (`RODADA_FIM`, 320 min): opcional sem tempo é pulado, o commit e a publicação sempre rodam.
- `atualiza.yml`: `continue-on-error` e `timeout-minutes` nos opcionais; tetos tirados dos tempos medidos de 22 a 26/10.
- `restaurar_parciais.py` antes da validação, e escrita atômica nos 7 pontos que gravavam direto em `site/`.
- `pessoas.py`: teto de 45 min, tempo curto por pedido, disjuntor; cortado, não publica e diz o que ficou pendente.

Testes novos: `tests/test_pessoas_rede.py` (12), `tests/test_passo_corte.py` (7), `tests/test_versionar_dados.py`, `emendas_obras.py --teste` (115). A regressão de pessoas (348) passa. Rodados também na árvore com os três PRs juntos.

**Publicação das emendas desligada por enquanto:** o passo diário roda com `--dry-run` (grava só em `cache/emendas/`) até a conferência à mão de uma amostra dos vínculos; para publicar, trocar `--dry-run` por `--publicar` no passo. Os tetos da rodada valem já na próxima rodada.

body:
Ítems R5, B3, la alerta del líder, la mitad de comentarios de R4, C1 y C5 de `agentes-linkedin/infra/docs/auditoria-arquitectura-ia.md`.

- **R5.** Antes de pagar un borrador en Opus, Jev mira el post con `lider.comment_worthy`. Hace cinco preguntas `noul`: sustancia, tema del barrio, vacante, promoción e hito personal.
  - El veredicto queda en un `AuditEvent`, así que un post no se vuelve a preguntar.
  - Como máximo 3 preguntas por ciclo.
  - Si Jev no responde, se redacta como antes.
  - Se ajusta con `COMMENT_PREFILTER` (true) y `COMMENT_PREFILTER_THRESHOLD` (0,5).
- **B3.** `LEAD_MAX_REVIEWS_PER_TICK` (5): el líder revisa de la propuesta más antigua a la más reciente y el resto espera al ciclo siguiente. Si Jev no responde, el ciclo deja de llamarlo hasta el siguiente. Las decisiones deterministas y la caducidad no esperan al tope.
- **Alerta de silencio.** Si en 7 días el líder revisó al menos `LEAD_SILENCE_MIN_REVIEWS` (5) propuestas de una capacidad en `auto` y no aprobó ninguna, llega la Notificación `lead_silent` (capa sistema, con push). Una por capacidad y semana.
- **R4 en comentarios.** Si el borrador solo falla reglas fijas de texto (hashtag, URL, longitud, venta), se reescribe una vez nombrando la regla concreta.
- **C1.** Las unidades del curso del comentario pasan a un bloque estable del system con `cache_control`, así que los borradores siguientes, incluida la reescritura, las leen a precio de caché. `providers.claude(..., context=)` es opcional: sin él, la solicitud sale igual que antes.
- **C5.** Se reutiliza el cliente de Anthropic (`lru_cache`).
- Incluye el ajuste de una prueba para R2 (#16): el líder ya pregunta `riesgo`, no `encaja`.

## Pruebas
- 275 OK con #16, de las cuales 24 son nuevas en `test_auditoria_lider.py`.
- Sin migraciones.

body:
## Qué cambia
- `/carreras`: cabecera compartida con índice de facultades (nombre y cantidad) y la línea «N programas en M facultades»; una sección por facultad con listas de filas por tipo (grado, posgrado) y una línea de sede, modalidad y duración; aviso en línea (ok/vacío/no disponible) y `error.tsx` propio, en los cuatro idiomas.
- `/carreras/[slug]`: cabecera con migas de tres niveles y ficha del programa (tipo, sede, modalidad, duración, título), sección de resoluciones del CONES con enlace, perfil si existe, bloque a la facultad y regreso al catálogo.
- Usa los campos del CMS que antes se ignoraban: la página anterior mostraba duración, título y modalidad (presentes en 7, 8 y 12 de las 62 carreras) y no tipo, sede ni resoluciones (presentes en las 62).
- Las facultades se enlazan con la ruta pública (`rutaFacultad`), la misma del menú.
- Nuevo modelo `lib/cms/carrerasCatalogo.ts` (`mapCarreraCatalogo`, `agruparPorFacultad`): no oculta carreras con tipo desconocido (quedan en «Otros programas»), no inventa datos y valida los enlaces de resolución con host exacto reutilizando `mapResoluciones` (ahora exportada de `lib/cms/facultad.ts`).
- El detalle propaga la caída del CMS a `error.tsx` y no la cachea como 404 (DEP-15); el catálogo la muestra como «no disponible» con «Intentar de nuevo».
- El esqueleto de carga ya no es oscuro; los datos estructurados usan migas traducidas y `timeRequired` en formato ISO 8601 (`P4Y`; antes se pasaba un número, que Schema.org no admite).

## Base y dependencia
Apila sobre #26 (`feat/noticias-rediseno`), que apila sobre #24 y #12. Este PR apunta a esa rama para mostrar solo su cambio; al fusionar los anteriores, retargetear.

## Verificación
- Suite completa: 150 archivos, 2509 pruebas. `tsc` y lint sin errores.
- Local con las 62 carreras reales: catálogo y detalle revisados en el navegador (escritorio 1280 px).
- No revisado: vista móvil.

## Límites
- Cambia el valor de `timeRequired` en el JSON-LD de cada carrera (número → ISO 8601); no estaba pedido, corrige un valor inválido.
- La ficha dice «Tipo: Carreras de grado»; «Nivel: Grado» sería más corto (texto, no estructura).
- `getCarreras` conserva su respaldo de demostración solo en desarrollo (DEP-19b); no se toca.

## Riesgo
Sin migraciones. Toca `lib/cms/facultad.ts` solo para exportar `mapResoluciones` (sin cambio de comportamiento).

author: ryanchild
body:
### Problem

When syncing FruitDeepLinks with APITuner, the following issues occurred:

1. **404 on `/api/adb/lanes` & Missing Protocol Scheme**:
   - Entering `fruitdeeplinks_url` without a scheme (e.g. `192.168.1.17:6655`) caused `httpx` to raise `httpx.UnsupportedProtocol`, which failed all endpoints and raised the hardcoded `404 on /api/adb/lanes` exception.
   - Even when entered with `http://`, FruitDeepLinks returns 404 on `/api/adb/lanes` because FruitDeepLinks' actual exported endpoint for provider lanes is `GET /api/provider_lanes`.
2. **Channel Number Collisions on `/m3u/adb` Fallback**:
   - Because `/api/adb/lanes` returned 404, APITuner fell back to `GET /m3u/adb`.
   - FruitDeepLinks generates `/m3u/adb` by concatenating per-provider 1-indexed lanes, assigning `tvg-chno="1"`, `tvg-chno="2"`, etc. for each provider (e.g. Prime Video 01, Apple MLB 01, Apple MLS 01, and ESPN+ 01 all have `tvg-chno="1"`).
   - `channels_from_m3u()` accepts the attribute number whenever present, bypassing `start_number` and failing to check for duplicate numbers. This resulted in the first four channels all being assigned channel number 1, ignoring `fruitdeeplinks_start_number`.
3. **XMLTV Path & Channel ID Mapping**:
   - The default `fruitdeeplinks_xmltv_path` was `/xmltv/adb`, which returns 404 on FruitDeepLinks (actual ADB XMLTV is exported to `/out/adb_lanes.xml`), causing a fallback to `/xmltv/lanes` (direct HLS lanes).
   - FruitDeepLinks exports channel IDs as `{provider}{lane:02d}` (e.g. `sportscenter02`, `aiv01`). `fdl_xmltv_aliases` only looked for 3-digit zero-padded (`sportscenter-002`) or hyphenated (`sportscenter-2`) patterns, dropping all programmes for ADB lanes. Additionally, the bare `code` alias caused multi-lane providers like ESPN+ to collide.

### Solution

1. **Query `/api/provider_lanes`**:
   - Try `GET /api/provider_lanes` first (with `/api/adb/lanes` as fallback). FruitDeepLinks' `/api/provider_lanes` payload matches `_parse_adb_providers()` directly, allowing Step 1 (`channels_from_adb_lanes`) to succeed and cleanly number channels sequentially starting from `fruitdeeplinks_start_number`.
2. **Auto-Prefix URL Scheme**:
   - `_base_url()` now ensures an `http://` prefix if the user omitted the protocol scheme.
3. **Renumber `/m3u/adb` Channels on Fallback**:
   - If sync ever has to fall back to `/m3u/adb`, channels are renumbered sequentially starting from `start_number` and respecting occupied channels, preventing provider lane index collisions.
4. **Add `apple_f1` Package Mapping**:
   - Added `apple_f1` to `deeplink_catalog.py` so Apple TV Formula 1 lanes are mapped to Apple TV app packages instead of being skipped.
5. **Update Default FDL XMLTV Path & Aliases**:
   - Default `fruitdeeplinks_xmltv_path` to `/out/adb_lanes.xml` (with `/out/adb_lanes.xml`, `/xmltv/adb`, `/xmltv/lanes`, `/xmltv/direct` fallbacks).
   - Add `{provider}{lane:02d}` to `fdl_xmltv_aliases` and remove the bare `code` alias to prevent collision between multiple lanes of the same provider.
6. **Tests & Docs**:
   - Added unit tests in `test_fruitdeeplinks.py` and `test_xmltv.py`.
   - Updated `INTEGRATION.md`, `README.md`, and frontend options in `app.js`.

author: zoroyihan7
body:
## What

Adds 53 synthetic cases to the super-agent evaluation's seed set (`claw/packages/api/test/e2e/sa-eval-cases/`), and a test that holds their shape.

| directory | cases | what it measures |
|---|---|---|
| `review-a8/cat-review-a8.jsonl` | 21 | review as another person (`{EVAL_OTHER_PERSON}`), merge confirmation (approve / deny / unknown ref / what waits), stopping a review; a PR that is already merged is answered with its merge time and merge commit instead of a review (`pr-state.ts`, `already_merged`) |
| `sim/multiturn.jsonl` | 17 | scripts of 3-5 turns that quote an earlier answer or change their mind: a corrected PR number, an item adjusted then cancelled (`items_closed`), a reviewer changed mid-conversation, a confirmation withdrawn, a return after a topic switch, a count repeated after a language switch |
| `catalog/recent-y8.jsonl` | 15 | what failed in real use on 2026-11-06/07: a review request while attached to a dev machine session must not go into the session (`devenv_send` must not be called), a session that could only be watched, the machine list going empty, web search that is down (say so, never invent), node / workload / PR counts that must be the total and not one page (SaFE `totalCount`, GitHub GraphQL `totalCount`) |

## How each case is decided

Every case has at least one check a run decides without a judge: a fact read at run time (GitHub REST `pulls/<n>#merged_at`, GitHub GraphQL counts, `/v1/work-items`, `/v1/remote-agents/connectors`, `mcp:safe/node_list` / `workload_list`), a fixture value, or `items_closed`. The new test `S9b` fails when a review-a8 set drops under 20, a script leaves 3-6 turns, or a new case has no decidable fact.

Cases that need the GitHub fixture PRs (`{{repo}}`, `{{pr_a}}`, `{{confirm_ref}}`, see the sim fixtures) or another person (`EVAL_OTHER_PERSON`) are skipped without them; none of them runs against a real repository. The merged-PR cases read fixed, already-merged PRs of this repository, which the review tool refuses before anything is started.

## Checks

- `tsx --test test/sa-eval.test.ts test/sa-eval-runner.test.ts`: 65 pass.
- `EVAL_STATIC=1 npx tsx test/e2e/sa-eval.ts` on the seed set: 76 cases, 0 not loaded, 0 problems (25 need run variables).

Scale round 2, items 1 and 2 (synthetic fixture, 3000 hosts; numbers in SCALE-REPORT.md when the matrix is final).

- `_heat_facets` computes each host's heat in the database: the hottest live CVE match (`match_heat_rank_expr`) and live finding (`finding_heat_rank_expr`) per row, then the host group `host_siblings` names. No model instance of a match, finding, address or port is built (was 64,500 for 3000 hosts). The old walk stays as `_heat_facets_walk`; `tests/test_scale_heat_sql.py` pins the two equal over fire / smoke / ice / patched / closed / ruled-out / manual override / informational / sibling-name / nuclei-ran hosts and checks a fixed query count.
- A bare-word term is an OR over eight relations. It was one subquery joining all of them (150,000 joined rows for 1,300 hosts, 300 ms, twice per search); each OR branch is now its own semi-join (`_host_has`), 70 ms. `tests/test_scale_search_branches.py` checks every branch finds what the single join found.

author: seoyeon59
body:
## 요약

2·3단계 필터링(`qupict/filtering.py`)을 기획안의 **"1차 규칙 필터 + 2차 LLM 검증"** 구조로 새로 만들고 DB에 연결했습니다.

> **베이스가 `feat/sense-db-cache`(#4)입니다.** #4 위에 이어서 만든 작업이라 이 PR에는 필터링 변경만 보입니다. 머지 순서: #2 → #3 → #4 → 이 PR.

### 흐름

| 순서 | 단계 | 하는 일 | DB 저장 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 중복 제거 | 임베딩 유사도 0.9 이상 → 본문이 가장 긴 기사만 대표 (이미 판정한 기사는 항상 대표 유지) | `duplicate_of` |
| 2 | 1차 규칙 (`stage=rule`) | 점수 = 연관어 − 배제어 (제목 2점·본문 1점, 기획안 방법 1-c). **검색어·별칭이 없거나 점수 ≤ −2인 분명한 경우만 무관** | `status`, `reason` |
| 3 | 2차 LLM (`stage=llm`) | 고른 의미 vs 고르지 않은 의미 대조 → **관련 / 무관 / 보류 + 근거 한 줄** | `status`, `reason`, `judged_model` |

- `filter_articles` (메모리, `run.py`) / `filter_topic` (DB: 새 기사만 판정, 임베딩·결과 저장, `redo=True`로 재판정 — 정답 라벨은 유지)
- `rule_check`는 실험 A의 "방법 1-c"로 그대로 쓸 수 있게 공개
- `run.py`: 예전 "LLM 제외 키워드 생성" 단계 제거, 0단계 배제어 사용. 답변에는 **관련 + 보류** 기사 사용 (Recall 보호)
- 예전 제외 키워드 필터(약 450줄)와 안 쓰는 설정 2개 삭제 (git 기록에 남음)

### 실제 운영에서 고친 점
처음 실행 때 LLM이 근거는 "지역 의미로 쓰임, 무관 쪽"이라 쓰고 판정은 '관련'으로 낸 경우가 있었습니다. 답 형식에서 **근거를 먼저, 판정을 나중에** 쓰게 순서를 바꿔 해결했습니다.

### DB 담당에게

author: cola968
body:
## Befund
Der neue NERAL-EXT-Lauf schreibt bislang alle 400 Modellantworten erst am Ende. Bei Timeout, Modellabbruch oder PC-Neustart gehen dadurch sämtliche bis dahin erzeugten Antworten verloren; die drei Varianten sind mit einer lokalen RTX 4070 entsprechend teuer zu wiederholen.

## Fix
- Neuer lokaler append-only JSONL-Zwischenstand pro Variant-Lauf, nach jeder generierten Antwort durch `fsync` gesichert.
- Resume überspringt **nur** bereits validierte, lückenlose Aufgabenpräfixe. Die finale Datei wird erst nach vollständigem Lauf atomar/create-only angelegt.
- SHA-256 bindet Zwischenstand an alle Testfälle, gerenderte Prompt-Nachrichten, Variante, versiegelte Foundation-Manifestdaten, LoRA-Gewichts-SHA und Decoding-Konfiguration.
- Inkonsistente, beschädigte, ungültige, unvollständige oder symlinked Zwischenstände blockieren den Lauf, statt unterschiedliche Ergebnisse zu mischen.
- Private Antworten bleiben lokal in `.progress`; GitHub/CI sehen nur synthetische CPU-Mocks.
- Unveränderte unabhängige Qwen-vs-Adapter-Scorer und unveränderte Modellgewichte.

## Tests / Gates
`tests/test_neral_ext_resume.py` prüft Unterbrechung nach zwei Fällen, Fortsetzen ohne doppelte Inferenz, Checkpoint-Verwechslung, Manipulation, unvollständige Antworten, Symlinks sowie Create-only-Verhalten. CI führt außerdem den bestehenden `test_neral_ext_run.py`-Vertrag aus.

Kein GPU-Training, kein self-hosted Workflow, keine automatische Adapter-Promotion. **Diesen Infrastrukturgewinn nicht als Modellintelligenz ausgeben.**

author: elajeff
body:
## Summary

The backend had two key caches (the round HMAC key in `game-session.js`, the session verifier key in `auth.js`). It also had the same code written two or three times in places: base64url decoding, the "session not initialized" guard, the live multiplier maths, the seed key loading, the origin check. This removes the caches and merges the copies. Gameplay and crash points are the same.

## Changes

- Dropped the round HMAC key cache. `startRoundCore` decrypts the seed and calls `hmacBytes`. `hmacBytesWithKey` is gone.
- Dropped the verifier key cache in `auth.js`. `verifySessionToken` imports the key itself. Updated the line in `docs/architecture.md`.
- `safeParse` removed, the three callers use `JSON.parse` (they only read JSON the Durable Object wrote, so a corrupt row now gives a 500 `internal_error` instead of a fallback value).
- `requireState` for the seven `session_not_initialized` guards, `liveMultiplierAt` for the multiplier maths in `alarm`, `cashOut` and `roundStatus`. Both are plain functions, because the test fakes call methods on bare objects.
- `settleBust` and `settleAtCap` are sync and return the settlement, callers wrap it in `json`. `roundStatus` settles with its own `serverTime`.
- `clearSettlementAlarm` always gets a round id, and `commitSettlement` calls `ctx.waitUntil` directly. `deferSettlementAlarmCleanup` is gone.
- Named `EARLY_RELEASE_WINDOW_MS`, `START_RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS` and `STORED_HISTORY_LIMIT`.
- Removed the same-seed shortcut in `setClientSeed`.
- `readRequestedMultiplierCents` validates, `resolveCashoutMultiplierCents` no longer validates again.
- `fromBase64Url` in `crypto-utils.js` for `auth.js` and `seed-crypto.js`, and `importSeedKey` for the two key loads in `seed-crypto.js`.
- `recordSettledRound` no longer checks the leaderboard before inserting, the DELETE already keeps the top five. Fixed the comment above it.
- `fairness` drops the `URLSearchParams` check and the 2,000,000,000 offset clamp.
- `index.js` reads only `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` and works out the allowed origin once.
- The decoded seed bytes aren't zeroed after the key import anymore.

## Testing

- `npm test` in `backend/`: 54 backend, 21 frontend, passing. No test edits. The fairness vectors are part of that run.
- Syntax loop from `checks.yml`: clean.
- On local workerd (`wrangler dev`, throwaway config): created a session, `/api/state` with the token gives 200, with a tampered token, a signature of odd length and no token gives 401. A round start (seed decrypt plus HMAC) gives 200. The integration test covers the token part in "health, CORS, and token authentication" and "session initializes with separate, authenticated state".
- Same workerd run: `/api/fairness?roundOffset=9007199254740991&seedOffset=9007199254740991` returns 200 with no SQLite error. OPTIONS and plain requests with an allowed origin get `access-control-allow-origin`, requests without Origin don't, a disallowed origin gets 403 on OPTIONS.
- Compared old and new `recordSettledRound` on in-memory SQLite, 3000 random sequences of 25 rounds each (with tied payouts and multipliers, with and without repeated timestamps): same `personal_bests` rows and `session_stats` every time.

## Risk

Small, with one thing to check. `index.js` no longer reads the old `ALLOWED_ORIGIN` variable, so a deployed Worker that only has that one set (and not `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`) would reject every browser origin with a 403. `wrangler.toml` has set `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` since the first commit. The other changes to replies: `roundStatus` stamps a settlement with the `serverTime` it already read instead of a second `Date.now()`, and `/api/fairness` echoes `roundOffset` and `seedOffset` as sent instead of capping them at 2,000,000,000.

author: andrewhuhh
body: ## Context With the v4 flag on, navigation between v3 and v4 was decided in several places, using a hand-kept LIVE_READY list on the v4 side and per-route redirects on the v3 side. They could disagree, which caused the redirect loop fixed in #9279. This PR replaces them with one resolver that both directions share. - **Readiness on each v4 route.** Each route sets `staticData.readiness` to `full`, `partial` or `none`, and partial routes name what's missing in `staticData.missing`. LIVE_READY and AUTH_PATHS are gone. Counts: 38 full, 16 partial, 2 none (the not-ported placeholders). - **One resolver**, `helpers/v4Bridge.ts`, used in both directions. It decides synchronously with `router.matchRoutes` on the `/v4` path, and treats a `/$` splat leaf, `globalNotFound` or `none` as a miss. - v3 to v4: one handoff in the v3 org layout and in the login middleware replaces `redirectToV4IfEnabled`. - v4 to v3: the sidebar, the command palette, the org route redirect, the auth guards and the not-ported routes all use the same miss check. - Legacy v3 aliases redirect first, and their targets are resolved on the next navigation. - **Open in classic.** Partial pages show a quiet "Open in classic" link in the top bar to their v3 twin. Following it marks that path for the session, so the classic page doesn't bounce back to v4. - **Flag resolved once.** `isV4AppEnabled` resolves once per session, so the 3 s PostHog wait no longer happens on every navigation. - **Cert Manager without an instance.** The Cert Manager dashboard and index show the same "not set up" state as inventory when the org has no Certificate Manager, instead of loading forever. - **Removal guidance.** frontend/AGENTS.md now has a "v4 bridge: remove at the full switch" section listing what to delete once every route reads `full`. Why it can't loop: v3 sends a path to v4 only when the flag is on and v4 has a page for it. v4 sends it back only when there's a miss and v3 has a page. Both read the same resolver and the flag is fixed for the session, so at most one direction applies to any path. ## Screenshots Open in classic on a partial page (Integrations): ![peach](https://api.capy.ai/pr-assets/PrakkExi54DGa5H3ul1ZfJ_eRTkQJjvxnyecqBxjoQY.png) ![dark](https://api.capy.ai/pr-assets/BAc4WeI6Bu4GTkbH2B5h0HWKQmxiqmnXXNVQxDk4Ocg.png) The MFA step stays in v4: ![mfa](https://api.capy.ai/pr-assets/iL1Vbhe2a_-pA7XtewcIWXP_ZHMUyS36h_2doLTj5UU.png) ## Steps to verify the change 1. With the flag on, open `/organizations//projects`. It hands off to `/v4/organizations//projects`. 2. Open Settings, Integrations and Certificate Manager. They stay in v4 and show Open in classic. 3. Open Billing. It goes to v3 and stays there. 4. Select Open in classic on a partial page. The v3 twin opens and stays after a reload. ## Type - [ ] Fix - [ ] Feature - [x] Improvement - [ ] Breaking - [ ] Docs - [ ] Chore ## Checklist - [x] Title follows the [conventional commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/#summary) format: `type(scope): short description` (scope is optional, e.g., `fix: prevent crash on sync` or `fix(api): handle null response`). - [x] Tested locally - [ ] Updated docs (if needed) - [x] Updated AGENTS.md files (if needed) - [x] Read the [contributing guide](https://infisical.com/docs/contributing/getting-started/overview)

author: fatherlinux
body:
The fix that lets a deploy succeed at all.

`RestartUnit` over D-Bus **queues a job and returns**, so verification ran while
the old container was still stopping, read `deactivating`, and failed on its
first sample. The rollback did the same. The first real deploy therefore
reported a healthy service as *"down, needs a person"*, cancelled its
maintenance window to page, and held it — and every deploy would have.

`restart` now waits for a new activation, proved by `ActiveEnterTimestamp`
rather than by `ActiveState`: the old instance is still `active` in the moment
between the job being queued and the stop beginning.

With it, `deployer unhold` forgives the revision its hold names, because that
bug permanently condemned a good commit and the only way back was editing the
state directory by hand. The constitution is amended to 0.2.0 to say what the
rule actually protects — nothing *automatic* retries a revision that broke a
service.

454 tests.

body:
## Summary
On the user's Android phone, Chrome refused to open the clock app's timer from the page (the `SET_TIMER` intent), and they don't want to install an app or get an email. So:

- **Countdown with the screen kept on:**
  - While a timed run started on this device is on, a countdown shows at the top of every tab: "⏰ 17:59 עד סוף הדוד (ליואב)".
  - The page asks the phone to keep the screen on (Screen Wake Lock), so its beep can sound at the end.
  - One tap ("לא צריך") stops keeping the screen on, and that choice is remembered.
  - The lock is taken again when the page comes back to the front.
  - The countdown and the lock go away when the time is up (with the beep), on "כיביתי", or when the run is deleted. `scheduleAlarms` now also runs on every render.
- **Removed:** the Android "⏰ טיימר בטלפון" offer and its fallback handler. An old `#timer-failed` hash is simply cleared. The iPhone calendar-alert offer stays.
- The boiler sheet's note now describes the countdown and the screen staying on.
- Script version tag bumped.

## Testing
Playwright with an Android user agent, a fake clock, and stand-ins for audio and wake lock:
- Starting an 18-minute run shows the countdown and takes the lock; there is no toast on Android any more.
- After 1 minute the countdown reads 16:59.
- "לא צריך" releases the lock; tapping again takes it back.
- The countdown stays visible on the journal tab.
- When the time is up: 4 beeps, the countdown is removed and the lock released.
- A 30-minute run switched off after 5 minutes: the countdown is removed and the lock released.
- UI regression tests pass; no page errors.

- Pass the current update range into outlier filtering to avoid reprocessing already validated fixes.

body: When MyGo Music releases, the new **Upstream** workflow has Claude Opus 5.5 (effort medium) check the release against the plugin, actually run things on the runner, and lyjw131[bot] comments the report on the tracking issue #2. ## How it works - **detect** (hourly): MyGo's latest release vs. the marker in the bot's last comment on #2. Several releases since the last check are checked together. - **analyze**: `scripts/upstream-watch.ts`, a tool loop on the Anthropic SDK. - Auth is GitHub OIDC → workload identity federation; no API key in the repo. - Tools: `bash`, `read_file`, `upstream_diff`, `install_packages`, `submit_report` (a fixed schema). - Environment: MyGo at every tag, the plugin built with amhelper, Go, Node, ffmpeg, xvfb. The runner is the model's to write and install on; bubblewrap only keeps its commands away from the job's OIDC request token. - **publish**: `scripts/upstream-watch/report.ts` renders the comment, stripping markers and @-mentions the model might write. Comments on scheduled runs, or on runs by hand that ask for one. ## Breakers - **A run:** it is told to hand in at 30 min or $5, and stopped at 1.5× either, or at 150 turns. - **A day:** at most 3 automatic runs. Releases past that wait and are checked with the next. - **Failures:** a release that failed isn't retried on its own. ## Playing without Apple `helper/cmd/fakeapple` is a fake wrapper and Apple CDN. It serves Temari's published encrypted sample in a loop, laid out as Apple's files are. Through the real amhelper it decrypts byte for byte to the clear copy. author: gavindu
body:
## Security boundary
A provider login click can await Chrome permissions and cookie reads. During that delay, the user can unpair or connect to a different gateway. The popup formerly used the eventual current linked-provider list without checking the install identity, so stale work could restore provider auto-sync consent after disconnect or carry it into another installation.

## Change
- Capture gateway origin and install token at the start of a provider link action.
- Fail closed if no active connection exists, or if origin/token changes before consent is persisted.
- Add deterministic regression tests for disconnect and re-pair while the cookie snapshot is pending.
- Align existing popup-flow fixture with a paired gateway.

## Validation
GitHub Actions must pass all required checks on this exact PR head. No live E2E here. Related to #129 and remote trust boundary #637; real linked-provider acceptance remains open.

author: arnoldwilliams
body:
## Summary

Creates a buildable .NET 10 MAUI sample (`TestApp.My.Mobile`) for Android and iOS push
notifications, and moves the device registration out of `MainActivity.OnCreate` into a view model.

The original code did the registration inline in `OnCreate`:

```csharp
if (DeviceInstallationService.NotificationsSupported)
{
    FirebaseMessaging.Instance.GetToken()
        .AddOnSuccessListener(new PNSTokenSuccessListener(token =>
        {
            DeviceInstallationService.Token = token;

            NotificationRegistrationService.RefreshRegistrationAsync(token)
                .ContinueWith(task => { if (task.IsFaulted) throw task.Exception; });
        }));
}
```

That block now lives in `PushNotificationViewModel.InitializeAsync`, invoked from
`MainPage.OnAppearing`. `MainActivity.OnCreate` keeps only platform plumbing (notification
channel, message bus, deep link handling).

## What changed

- **View model owns registration.** `PushNotificationViewModel` handles permission, token
  resolution, register, deregister and token refresh, and exposes observable state for the UI.
- **Platform abstractions.** `IPushNotificationService`, `IPushNotificationEventSink`,
  `IDeviceInstallationService`, `INotificationRegistrationService`.
- **Android.** `AndroidDeviceInstallationService`, `AndroidPushNotificationService`,
  `TestAppFirebaseMessagingService`, `PNSToken{Success,Failure,Complete}Listener`, `MainActivity`.
  `OnNewToken` now raises an event instead of registering directly.
- **iOS.** `iOSDeviceInstallationService`, `iOSPushNotificationService`, `AppDelegate` with the
  full APNs path (permission, register, token, tap).
- **Registration service.** `RefreshRegistrationAsync` returns a result instead of throwing from
  `ContinueWith`, so a failed registration cannot crash the UI thread.
- **DI.** One platform service instance is registered behind both `IPushNotificationService` and
  `IPushNotificationEventSink` so events reach the view model.

## Verification

```
dotnet build TestApp.My.Mobile/TestApp.My.Mobile.csproj -f net10.0-android
Build succeeded.
    0 Error(s)
```

0 errors and 0 C# warnings (clean build, `net10.0-android`, .NET SDK 10.0.403, Android SDK
API 36, JDK 21). The iOS target requires macOS/Xcode and was not compiled here; its files mirror
the Android structure and are covered by the documentation.

Notable build fixes documented in the docs:

- Pinned `Xamarin.AndroidX.Fragment.Ktx` (1.9.0) and `Xamarin.AndroidX.Collection.Ktx` (1.6.0.1)
  to avoid R8 `FragmentKt is defined multiple times` failures with MAUI 10.
- `dotnet build -t:InstallAndroidDependencies` needs a non-empty `USER` env var in containers.

## Documentation

- `docs/push-notification-registration.md` — architecture, sequence diagrams, the view-model
  change, Android/iOS details, DI, setup and a manual test matrix.
- `README.md` — quick layout, build and configuration.

The original reference files remain at the repository root for comparison.

author: wynn-dev
body:
Phone agents couldn't run `expo prebuild --platform ios` on the agents' Mac. It had neither CocoaPods nor Homebrew, only system Ruby 2.6, which is too old for any current CocoaPods. This PR uses Homebrew for CocoaPods instead of a user-local gem install into the shared cache. Homebrew's CocoaPods comes with its own Ruby, so nothing needs compiling and there are no gem pins to maintain. A prebuilt Ruby in the shared cache would mean keeping Ruby and every gem pinned ourselves.

I did find a gem set that works on Ruby 2.6 (activesupport 6.1, minitest 5.25, zeitwerk 2.6). It still needs two native builds (ffi and nkf), and those need a usable Xcode, so this PR drops that route.

## What changes
- **`mac_tools`** runs Homebrew's `pod --version` (from `/opt/homebrew/bin` or `/usr/local/bin`, so the brew install the person is doing now counts).
  - **Green:** the pinned tools are installed and pod runs. The message adds "CocoaPods <version>."
  - **Missing or broken:** the check warns (amber), so setup still ends. Its fix is the one command for the person's own (admin) Terminal: `/opt/homebrew/bin/brew install cocoapods`. When there's no `brew`, Homebrew's own install line goes first. On Intel the path is `/usr/local/bin/brew`.
  - It checks again every 30 s.
- **Jobs (`mac run`)** get Homebrew's bins at the end of their PATH, skipping any already there. They also get `LANG=en_US.UTF-8` when the node has no LANG: CocoaPods won't run outside UTF-8, and a launchd service has none.
- **Docs and help:** agents-mac.md covers why CocoaPods comes from Homebrew, the two commands, the `mac_tools` row and the job PATH/LANG. The hub's guided Mac step and the `mac` help text mention it too.

## Tests
- Fakes cover each state of the check: pod running, including Ruby warnings printed before the version; Homebrew there but no pod; no Homebrew, where the fix depends on where brew installs on each chip; and pod failing to run. The pinned tools' Installing and Failed states are unchanged.
- `job_env` tests cover Homebrew's bins appended, a PATH that already has one (no duplicate), and LANG set or kept.
- `scripts/check.sh` reports this tree pushable.

Not tried on a real Mac. Once Homebrew and CocoaPods are in, `mac_tools` on the agents' Mac should turn green with the CocoaPods version.

author: pcbeingused333
body:
With _Financial Modeling Prep_ as data source, looking up the historical market price of a single date (`GET api/v1/symbols/:dataSource/:symbol/:dateString`, used e.g. by the historical market data editor in the admin control panel) never returns a price.

**Cause:** `FinancialModelingPrepService.getHistorical` keeps only rows with `isBefore(date, currentTo)`. For a single-day request (`from == to`, as `SymbolService.getForDate` issues), the requested date is excluded, so the result is always `{}`. `getDividends` and the Yahoo service already handle this by extending `to` by one day.

**Fix:** extend `to` by one day when `isSameDay(from, to)`, the same way `getDividends` does.

**Test:** new `financial-modeling-prep.service.spec.ts` with a mocked `FetchService`: single-day request returns that day's price; a multi-day range still excludes its end date.

author: jeeth-ops
body:
## Undo lag (both panels)
Every scoring action and every Undo wrote the whole undo stack to browser storage: up to 300 full copies of the match state. On the Harris Shield Test (1,013 deliveries) that was **228 MB of JSON per click**, freezing the panel for about 1.2 s. It is also far more than the ~5 MB browser storage holds.

The fix:
- **Shared snapshots.** Unchanged deliveries and state sections are shared between snapshots as frozen copies, and restoring a snapshot builds a fresh state from it.
- **Bounded persistence.** Only the latest 40 steps are kept across a reload, stored once each, within a size budget, and written just after the click rather than during it.
- **Migration.** The old full-copy stack is read once and then removed.

Undo on that match went from **1,224 ms to ~20 ms**. While a server-backed undo is still waiting, another press is ignored, so one press = one undo.

## Missing wagon wheel shots in the finished-match commentary
That match's live room holds **301** marked shots; its stored deliveries held **108**.
- **Cause:** the shot retry queue lived only in browser storage. Once the old undo stack filled storage, writes failed silently and shots were never sent.
- **Panels:** the queue now lives in memory. When a decided match is saved, every shot is sent again.
- **Server:** a lost shot is copied from the room's live ball log only when delivery id, innings, over and ball all agree. All 193 lost shots of that match qualify.
- **Recovery:** a restore from the panel state now keeps each delivery's shot.

## End-of-over graphics, 2 s after the over (both panels)
- The Over Summary / Batting / Bowling card goes on air 2000 ms after the over's last ball. The score is not delayed.
- Before firing, it checks the same match, the same innings, and that the over's last delivery is still in the log. So Undo, Reset or a match switch inside the 2 s puts nothing on air.
- The over's runs and wickets are now counted from the ball log. The old counter was not rewound by Undo, so a re-bowled last ball showed "2 runs" instead of 9; this bug is on `main` too.
- After an Undo, a stale automatic player card is cancelled.

## Economy always the last column
Bowling order is now `O M R W 0s NB WD Econ`. Fixed in:
- the overlay's manual bowling card
- the website's Summary tab
- the PDF's Best Bowling table (it had no Maidens), in `match-report.js` and both panels' copies

## Graphics and wagon wheel
- **TOP / BEST tags:** TOP for the top scorer and BEST for the best bowling. The manual card's total and standout figure get a short lift and sweep (transform/opacity only).
- **Short cards and logos:** a short card's rows fill the sheet, and logos are decoded before the cards need them.
- **Laptop wheel:**
  - It no longer spins in: clicks in its first half second were placed up to 12.5 field units off.
  - The marker appears the instant the click lands, with a saved tick.
  - The region of a boundary pick now lights up.
- **Phone Remote:** the docked wheel takes the first tap; taps in its first 300 ms used to be dropped silently.
- **Website commentary wheel:** fours and sixes glow, the 30-yard circle is shaded, and a fresh boundary rings once.

## Tests
- **New:** `undo-history-test` 94/94, `shot-persistence-test` 28/28 (it fails on the old panel), `over-end-delay-test` 44/44.
- **End to end:** `broadcast-graphics-test` 142/142, real panels + server + overlay in Chromium.
- **Full suite:** 65 of 75 pass. 9 others fail the same checks on `main` or don't start there either (missing `jsqr`, an extraction error). `hero-layout` fails only because of a hard-coded browser path and passes against the installed browser.
- `recovery-test` runs again; it was broken on `main`.

author: stachudotnet
body:
- Row readers in ScmActions, PackageOpPlayback, Inserts and Seed use a new Sqlite.readRows instead of a ResizeArray and a mutable flag.
- Seed: value evaluation is a recursive pass loop over Ply.List.mapSequentially results; the fold counts unreadable ops from the chunk lengths instead of inside List.choose.
- ReferenceDependencies, ReferenceNamesContent, ReferenceNames: indexed names are a fold, stored names are read up front into a Map, the review BFS walks level by level over a Set, and caller expansion threads its edges and fetched set through a recursive loop instead of a closure writing outer state.
- HashStabilization: items are a list folded into maps, and computeRealHashes folds the op pairs into an Input.
- PackageManager: the in-memory overlay folds bindings into one Map split by kind, pairItems is a fold, and liveAt uses Ply.List.filterMapSequentially.
- WipRefresh: the re-resolve loop is a list of steps run with Ply.List.mapSequentially, and the retry loop is recursive.
- Traces.recordedAt recurses up the parent chain; the blob purge sums deletions with a fold; PackagePermissions builds inert values and the contract differences without mutation.

Behaviour is unchanged.

author: slicit
body:
Refs #995 (not closed by this PR: close it once a device on iOS 27 has launched the app).

## Problem

With the iOS 27 SDK, an app that does not adopt the UIScene life cycle stops at launch in `UIApplicationMain` (`EXC_BREAKPOINT`, `___UIApplicationEvaluateRuntimeIssueForNoSceneLifecycleAdoption`). The generated iOS apps still use the app-delegate-only life cycle (`CDVAppDelegate` of Cordova iOS 6.1.1 creates the window itself, no scene manifest).

## Change (the 3 iOS shells: `ios`, `ios-noads`, `ionic/platforms/ios`)

- `AppsMobileCompany-Info.plist`: `UIApplicationSceneManifest`, single window, scene delegate `SceneDelegate`.
- `AppDelegate.h/.m`: new `SceneDelegate` (in the same files, so `project.pbxproj` is unchanged). It creates the window on the scene, shows it, and assigns it to `appDelegate.window`, so everything that reads `[UIApplication sharedApplication].delegate.window` (the web view delegate, keyboard, share) keeps working. `didFinishLaunching` no longer calls `CDVAppDelegate`'s window set up; it still creates the view controller and keeps the audio session and cleanup code.
- Opened URLs: the URL that launches the app and those received while it runs arrive on the scene, not on `application:openURL:options:`; they are forwarded to `CDVAppDelegate`, which posts the usual Cordova notifications (the HandleOpenUrl plugin keeps a cold-start URL until the page has loaded).

Based on the patch described in #995. iOS only: Android has no scenes. Recorded in `docs/mobile-parity.md`.

## Tests

- New `IosSceneLifecycleTest`: manifest and delegate name in each plist (well-formed XML), the window created on the scene and handed to the app delegate, URL forwarding, the three shells identical. Full suite: 541 passed.
- `ios-build` workflow on this branch (Xcode 26 on the runner): compiles. **The runner cannot launch an iOS 27 app, and nothing was run on a device.**

## What needs a device (iOS 27 and an older iOS, e.g. 17 or 18)

- Cold launch and background/foreground.
- A URL scheme or deep link: cold start and while running.
- Push notification opening the app, the keyboard, rotation (iPad too), the hidden status bar option.
- `UIApplication.statusBarFrame` and `keyWindow` are used by a few plugins (status bar, keyboard, share, AdMob): deprecated with scenes, worth watching on iOS 27.
